svg.text: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः । तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समा
yajñārthāt karmaṇo ’nyatra loko ’yaṁ karma-bandhanaḥ / tad-arthaṁ karma kaunteya mukta-saṅ
Work done for the satisfaction of the Lord frees us from bondage; otherwise action binds. Therefore act with detachment
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
